words.word: he that is wounded in the stones

occurrences.text: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the Lord.
words: He that is wounded in the stones

occurrences.text: Then he found another man, and said, Smite me, I pray thee. And the man smote him, so that in smiting he wounded him.
The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
